name: HTB Certified Penetration Testing Specialist

fee.note: HTB does not show the voucher price on its public pages; vouchers are bought from the HTB Academy billing page after signing in. Since 12 October 2026 the Silver Annual plan ($550 a year) bundles two vouchers: HTB CJCA and one Specialist certification. Monthly plans need a separate voucher.

exam.format: Black-box web, external and internal penetration test of a real-world Active Directory network over VPN, with no multiple-choice questions. The lab stays open for 10 days and the report must be uploaded within those 10 days; candidates submit flags, need a points threshold and a commercial-grade report that an instructor grades.
exam.passing: Points threshold (not published) plus an accepted report

scope: Practical penetration testing: web, external and internal testing of an Active Directory network, exploitation, lateral movement and professional reporting.
requirements: Complete the HTB Academy Penetration Tester job-role path (28 modules, each with a skills assessment) to 100% and hold an exam voucher before starting the exam.
ai_policy: HTB's help center says using AI to complete exam tasks breaks the certification exam terms: no pasting exam data into public AI models, no AI-written report and no autonomous agents. Local reference use, such as checking command syntax, is described as allowed.
caveats: Each voucher includes two attempts. After feedback on a failed first attempt there are 14 days to start the retake, which also runs for 10 days. Vouchers expire one year after purchase.
Results are delivered within 20 business days of submitting the report.
HTB publishes no domain weights and no exact points threshold.

access.retake: Each voucher includes two attempts: after the instructor's feedback on a failed first attempt you have 14 days to start the retake, which also runs for 10 days.

prep.title: HTB Academy: Penetration Tester job-role path
prep.note: Completing it to 100% is required before the exam.
